statusVocabulary.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The required outcome has no implementation in the cited source.
statusVocabulary.PARTIAL: Some of the required outcome exists in source. The recorded gap remains. A cited file is not verification.
statusVocabulary.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED: The recorded source outcome is present in the cited files. Native and browser qualification are separate.
statusVocabulary.SOURCE_VERIFIED: The cited suites were executed and every test file passed in full with no skip, against the recorded revision and file hashes (gate0-source-verification.json). A test file that exists is not verification. This is not a native PostgreSQL pass and not operational acceptance.
statusVocabulary.NATIVE_PENDING: The recorded source outcome is present and the blocking remainder is an unrecorded native or credentialed runtime proof.
statusVocabulary.EXTERNAL_GATE: A named external owner holds the missing proof. operationallyActivated is false.
statusVocabulary.SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED: The frozen source cites the identifier without a distinct in-repository outcome. This is not an implementation claim.
